mapper.sql: id, user_id, meeting_room_id, meeting_title, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, attendee_count, status, reject_reason, approve_time, approver_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (user_id, meeting_room_id, meeting_title, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, attendee_count, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{meetingRoomId}, #{meetingTitle}, #{reservationDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{attendeeCount}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM reservation
WHERE status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date >= #{weekStartDate} AND reservation_date < DATE_ADD(#{weekStartDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND status IN (0, 1, 4) ORDER BY reservation_date ASC, start_time ASC

SELECT
FROM reservation WHERE reservation_date = #{date} AND status IN (0, 1, 4) ORDER BY start_time ASC
